Prerequisites include basic programming skills and familiarity with Python, as well as a basic understanding of linear algebra and calculus. The course will cover topics such as supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, and deep learning architectures, as well as the use of popular libraries and frameworks like TensorFlow and Keras.
